conventions.biological_status: electrical proxies only, no recruitment/force/safety inference

signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

equal_total_power.interpretation: numerical normalization only; baseline limits are not human safety limits
equal_total_power.source_Vpp_definition: Actual full source waveform max-minus-min before50ohm; analytic control or coherent bounds, not per-tone Vpp

verification_tolerance.units: W for power and mA for stored output current vector

signed_per_output_power_evidence.definition: Peak phasors: Videal=Vmetal+50I; P=.5Re(V*conj(I)); resistor=50|I|^2/2; RMS=sqrt(sum_f|I|^2/2)
signed_per_output_power_evidence.signed_power_scope: Metal delivered power includes passive-output absorption; no negative value clamped
signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

source_waveform.interpretation: ONE global upper-bound scaling preserves every intra-frequency ratio/cancellation. Each output<=1Vpp; only maximum output upper is1Vpp; not each output exactly1Vpp

selected_layouts.numerical_validation_scope: Native equation gates and stored sampled2074 volume metrics; mesh/contact/experiment validation held

design.area_policy: Fixed900mm2 total; source/return allocation and outer lengths vary jointly; arm10 and centres fixed

conventions.maxTIS: max over finite sampled n of 2min(|n·E_f0|,|n·E_f1|)

conventions.fixed_modulation_depth: min(carrier projection magnitudes)/max; undefined for two zero projections
conventions.weighted_quantile: first ascending value reaching requested cumulative volume (inverse ECDF)
conventions.biological_status: electrical proxies only, no recruitment/force/safety inference
